message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.not_yet: You have not heard what this heart says yet.
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.offer: The heart is still beating. The warden's nightmare is open (next: tier %1$s, %2$s).
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.busy: The warden is awake now. Wait until it is over.
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.far: The nightmare only opens from beside the altar.
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.locked: The nightmare stays shut until the warden falls.
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.wake: Deep in the heart, the nightmare opens its eyes. Tier %1$s: %2$s. %3$s
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.wave_again: The dark wave comes once more.
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.lantern_dark: This lantern does not light in this tier.
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.cleared_first: First time past nightmare tier %1$s. %2$s xp, %3$s arts points.
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.special_5: Tier 5 is past. The dark voice called a name for the first time.
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.special_10: Tier 10 is past. This party's name is carved onto the heart's altar.
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.tier.1.name: The Short Light
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.tier.1.rule: Every lantern lasts a quarter less (30 s, 22.5 s, 15 s). Health +10%.
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.tier.2.name: Two Claws
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.tier.2.rule: After a claw, the same fan comes again one second later (red warning). Health +20%.
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.tier.3.name: Fangs of the Shades
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.tier.3.rule: The shades use the real claw and lunge. Damage +10%, health +30%.
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.tier.4.name: Six Lanterns
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.tier.4.rule: Only six lanterns. The seventh and eighth do not light. Health +40%.
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.tier.5.name: Twice Dark
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.tier.5.rule: The dark wave comes twice; the second at 12% health. Damage +20%, health +50%.
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.tier.6.name: The Returning Dark
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.tier.6.rule: In the dark, if nothing hits it for six seconds, the warden recovers 0.5% a second. Health +60%.
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.tier.7.name: The Chasing Lunge
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.tier.7.rule: After a lunge, a second lunge follows after a short pause (red warning). Damage +30%, health +70%.
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.tier.8.name: Swift Snuffing
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.tier.8.rule: The snuffing warning shrinks from three seconds to two. Health +80%.
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.tier.9.name: Deeper Dark
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.tier.9.rule: In the dark, hits deal 15% (the outline art still gives 60%). Damage +40%, health +90%.
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.tier.10.name: Pulse of the Heart
message.skyabyss.abyss_nm.tier.10.rule: Every twelve seconds a red ring (radius 5, two-second warning) closes around the altar. Standing in it hurts. Damage +50%, health +100%.
